reviews.text: We needed 4 very tall pines removed. Doug’s Tree Servce came out asap to assess the job and put us on their schedule. The crew and their high tech equipment did an excellent job! Very experienced and professional!
reviews.author: Carol A.

reviews.text: Absolutely recommend, I needed emergency tree removal and they came next day and did a awesome job. The crew was great and professional and very helpful. Cleaned up everything.
reviews.author: Eva M.

reviews.text: I had a large limb break and crash onto our pergola. It was suspended over my koi pond. I called Doug and they were out at the house within 3 days to come and remove it.
reviews.author: Greg W.
